description: Pins the official daily FMCSA Company Census metadata, streams a server-side minimized STATUS_CODE=A and PHY_COUNTRY=US export, and publishes source-specific active regulatory registration candidates with principal-office geography and no inferred legal organization.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only the exact HTTPS Company Census metadata, selected Socrata CSV resource, aggregate JSON resource, and pinned data-dictionary attachment paths on data.transportation.gov.
retry: Retry only transient metadata or file acquisition failures. Reject and restart when rowsUpdatedAt or aggregate counts change during acquisition; do not retry schema, filter, ordering, duplicate-USDOT, checksum, count, or quality-gate failures against the same snapshot.
checkpoint: The exact selected CSV and official dictionary are retained and hashed before normalization; the source metadata timestamp and counts are checked before and after acquisition; current.json changes only after every gate passes.
idempotency: Socrata rowsUpdatedAt plus selected-source SHA-256, pinned selected-schema fingerprint, and exact export-query SHA-256 identify a source release; USDOT creates a stable provisional principal-office site and establishment candidate.
cancellation: Stop network and local streams cooperatively, close partition writers, leave unpublished run-scoped staging, and do not change current.json before complete publication.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal minimized source evidence and approved normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
